title: Publish the site to GitHub Pages
description:
## What this does

- Adds `.github/workflows/pages.yml`. On every push to main it runs the tests, builds the site and publishes it to GitHub Pages.
- Adds `scripts/build.js`, which writes `dist/index.html` and `dist/version.json`. `version.json` holds the commit the site was built from.

Before merging: in Settings, then Pages, set Source to GitHub Actions.

files..github/workflows/pages.yml:
# Tests the site, builds it, and publishes it to GitHub Pages on every push to main.
name: Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Run the tests
        run: node --test
      - name: Build the site and version.json
        run: node scripts/build.js
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
